crossRefs.note: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife.…
I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant…
Jacob fled into the country of Aram, and Israel served to get a wife, and for a wife he tended flocks and herds.
He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia…
Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea, and greeted Festus.

people.name: Beersheba
people.line: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.

people.name: Haran
people.line: A city in Mesopotamia, associated with Abraham and his family.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Haran.
translations.kjv: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
translations.asv: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.
